title: `tools/call`
description: The request that invokes a tool by name with an arguments object and returns its result.
question: Can the framework invoke an MCP tool and hand the result back to the agent?
notes: Both adapters that reach 2026-07-28 invoke the tool and return its result to the agent; 3 cannot reach the revision.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI 1.15.1 requires MCP Python SDK 1.26.x, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2 requires mcp<2.0.0, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.3: Mastra 1.17.3 negotiated MCP 2025-11-25. The scanner refused to compare that capture with a 2026-07-28 source.

verdict.headline: Invocation works in both adapters that reach 2026-07-28.
verdict.detail: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 returns the SDK ToolOutput and Pydantic AI 2.40.0 returns the value the agent receives from a tool call. What survives inside that result varies sharply by content kind; see the individual result capabilities. CrewAI, LangChain and Mastra cannot negotiate MCP 2026-07-28, so they reach none of it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Every tool-definition row in this table is inert if the adapter never reaches this call. This is the floor of MCP support: a framework that renders a tool definition but cannot invoke it has integrated a catalogue, not a protocol.
